<a id="script_loop_stack"></a>
### [`script_loop_stack`](../../../../src/data/workspace.asm#L9) `$4F00`

*variable*

Loop stack of op 5: 5 bytes for each open loop (loop address lo, hi, count, script_ptr lo, hi of the op 5). Up to 10 loops.

- **Read by:** [`script_op_loop`](../script/opcodes.md#script_op_loop)
- **Written by:** [`script_op_loop`](../script/opcodes.md#script_op_loop)

<a id="script_arg_stack"></a>
### [`script_arg_stack`](../../../../src/data/workspace.asm#L26) `$4F46`

*variable*

Argument stack of the script ops. Ops 14, 27-30 push to it; an opcode with bit 7 set pops its operands from it.

- **Read by:** [`script_pop_arg`](../script/interpreter.md#script_pop_arg)
- **Written by:** [`zoom_choose_area`](../zoom/zoom_choose_area.md#zoom_choose_area), [`script_op_push_bytes`](../script/opcodes.md#script_op_push_bytes), [`script_op_push_dest`](../script/opcodes.md#script_op_push_dest)

*variable*

<a id="disk_command"></a>
### [`disk_command`](../../../../src/data/workspace.asm#L62) `$4F6A-$4F7F`

*variable*

Buffer of 18 bytes for a disk command ($4f6a-$4f7b): "N0:" or "S0:" and a name. The storage scripts at $24b8 and $24d1 write it (op 1 $4f6a, then op 2); the code at $2c7d gives it to SETNAM.
